concept.left_action: sleeps late in a rumpled bed near noon
concept.left_setting: a minimal bedroom at the start of a slow Saturday
concept.right_action: walk side by side through a small farmers market, sharing the morning outing
concept.right_setting: a minimalist farmers market later in the same Saturday
concept.shared_environment: One continuous pastel background, consistent character scale, rounded prop language, and matching weekend-day simplicity connect the two Saturday snapshots.
concept.environmental_contrast: Left is an inactive late bedroom. Right is a calm market outing with gentle movement and shared discovery.
execution_risks: Treat this as a deliberate before-and-after weekend contrast
Keep the market to one stand with no crowd
Characters remain on the floor with no visible legs
concept.emotional_insight: Sleepy and unmotivated, never cheerful. The same moment feels warmer together.

concept.left_action: stands alone near the snack table holding one red plastic cup
concept.left_setting: a small minimalist indoor party room
concept.left_emotion: Nervous, awkward, and unsure where to stand—never happy.
concept.right_action: stand close together, each holding one red plastic cup, laughing and dancing while looking at each other
concept.right_setting: the same small minimalist indoor party room
concept.right_emotion: Lively, playful, and warm because they are together.
concept.shared_environment: Same small indoor party room with one snack table, balloons, the same floor, and the same camera view.
concept.environmental_contrast: Left has deflated balloons, sparse snacks, and stillness. Right has floating balloons, fuller snacks, confetti, and movement.
execution_risks: Keep cups correctly scaled and do not create fingers
Keep the snack table secondary and both characters on the floor
concept.emotional_insight: Nervous, awkward, and unsure where to stand—never happy. The same moment feels warmer together.

concept.left_emotion: Neutral, bored, or gently sad—never happy.
concept.right_emotion: Warm and connected because the moment is shared.
concept.shared_environment: One flower or favorite snack, close-up

concept.left_action: Looks down at an unfinished floor puzzle and holds one loose piece.
concept.right_action: Crawls beside him and checks beneath the cushion for the missing piece.
concept.shared_environment: One continuous library nook with mint walls, peach shelves, a lavender rug, and a sunlit window.
concept.environmental_contrast: An incomplete picture becomes a joint search.
execution_risks: Show a clearly incomplete puzzle without clutter.
Use one readable search action for each character.
concept.emotional_insight: Help does not need to solve everything to make frustration smaller.
